svg.text: One adjacent N/L bar pair per task, only after all three repetitions have accepted proofs in both conditions.
Absolute mean seconds above bars; each task has its own scale. Blue = N; orange = L. Generated 2026-09-20 17:23 UTC.
Pending, scored-failure, and infrastructure tasks have no three-run mean. Token means are observed lower bounds if incomplete.
